pages.text: Brane cosmology says our universe is a membrane adrift in a higher-dimensional $(thing)Bulk$(). The $(item)Brane Shifter$() slips me sideways into it, and back. It requires the Brane Cosmology research.

First crossing. The Bulk is an endless void of floating islands under the shadow of a vast hypercube - a four-dimensional cube, of which I only ever see a 3D shadow. Monoliths hide vaults of exotic materials, and $(item)Void Lattice Ore$() is common here.
Physics aside: in brane-world models only gravity leaks out into the Bulk, which might be why it is so much weaker than the other forces. Standing out here, I believe it.
Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Brane Shifter$(): Cantor Key, Horizon Diver, Planck Diver
